news.title: Building Resilience Against Artificial Intelligence–Enabled Biological Threats: Conference Proceedings from a Follow-Up RAND and Helena Workshop, May 2026
news.summary_en: The authors share the results of a second workshop to explore options for implementing mitigations to combat the potential for AI-enabled biology to be misused to cause harm. They identify potential policy levers, operational steps, and trade-offs.

news.title: Regulating Artificial Intelligence Design to Prevent Youth Mental Health Harms
news.summary_en: This viewpoint examines the mental health risks AI chatbots pose to young people and outlines four regulatory priorities, including safety standards, independent testing, protective defaults, and harm monitoring.

news.title: Suicide-Related Responses From AI Chatbots Through Application Programming Interfaces and Consumer-Facing Apps: Observational Cross-Sectional Comparative Study
news.summary_en: This study examines how frequently AI chatbots provide direct responses to suicide-related prompts across access modes and whether response patterns differ between consumer-facing UI and API access across models and prompt risk levels.
